newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT-Siam Cement rated a "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Siam Cement rated a "buy".

text.p: Asia Equity Ltd on Wednesday rated Siam Cement Plc a "buy", saying the Thai industrial group is expected to benefit from increased structural steel sales by one of its units in 1997 after Thailand's enforcement of anti-dumping measures.
"We estimate that Siam Yamato Steel Co Ltd (SYS) should be able to increase its sales price by 11 percent following enforcement of the anti-dumping measures," Asia Equity said.

Asia Equity said SYS could boost its capacity utilisation to 95 percent in 1997 from an estimated 75 in 1996 since Polish imports made up about 20 percent of 120,000 tonnes of structural steel sold in Thailand in 1996.

The Thai government last December imposed an additional 25.90-51.99 percent tariff on top of an earlier 10-20 percent levy on structural steel from Poland following complaints by local producers of cheaper imports from that country.
Siam Cement holds a 51 percent stake in Siam Yamato Steel with the rest owned by Yamato Steel Co Ltd of Japan.
Siam Cement declined 12 baht to 688 at the lunch break on Wednesday.
